argv: Independent focused review of frozen native live KMS submission and always-reverting preview. Read/Grep only inside snapshot; no writes/commands/tests/network/agents. About 16-22 calls. Inspect new system/scanout.rs and restore.rs, plus atomic.rs, target_test.rs, Driver lifecycle/event integration system.rs, and probe.rs. Primary pinned DRM bindings/FFI and installed drm UAPI headers are supplied. Find concrete reachable HIGH/MEDIUM defects, especially early buffer reuse, rollback cloning lifetime, raw ioctl numbers/pointers, GEM-handle cleanup, CLOSEFB vs RMFB, callback ticket identity, uncertain submit retention, mode restoration and CLI timer/health. RestoreState captures exactly request properties with allowlist, copies blobs and clones foreign framebuffer backing references (not pixels), tests both old/new states. Live initial submit is NONBLOCK|PAGE_FLIP_EVENT|ALLOW_MODESET; subsequent FB-only submits omit ALLOW_MODESET. FrameQueue owns buffers BEFORE commit and treats every syscall failure as uncertain. Blocking rollback success is the only IdleProof; CLOSEFB releases restored clones without disabling planes. Drop of armed Output leaks whole state including broker lease and persistent-pool quota; seat loss/hotplug explicitly abandons instead of stale restoration. This containment is documented as incomplete production recovery. One preview/GPU, no combined multi-output transaction, no main compositor native backend. Probe opt-in --session --preview-output DEVICE:CONNECTOR issues 3 completion-driven RGB frames then always rollback at 15sec timer or termination; no keep option. Timer starts before live begin but synchronous calls have no universal deadline. No physical --session path has been run; tests are device-free. Do not relabel these disclosed qualification gaps as implemented behavior. Check static safety/correctness beyond tests, with concrete paths/triggers; concise findings/remaining limits/verdict. No certification.
